code:
10:30 AM Tuesday - approval-routing feature goes live

Within the hour:
  - high-value requests routed for 2nd approval
  - department heads never get a notification email
  - requests sit unactioned, no error visible to anyone
caption: Deployed mid-business-hours, because the build happened to be ready.

steps.sub: approval records are created correctly; approvals ARE processing

code:
Notification script reads: request.department_head

For newer request types, that field can be EMPTY
when the 2nd-approval step first fires.

No null check -> notification silently fails to send
caption: One missing null check, in one script.

code:
Revert the whole feature?
  -> re-opens the compliance gap it was built to close

Roll forward instead:
  - add the missing null check
  - fall back to a default escalation group when empty
caption: Known root cause, moderate severity, a costly revert — roll forward wins.
